posix_invariant_rules.name: Destructive Root Wipe Guard
posix_invariant_rules.posix_rationale: Prevents irreversible recursive deletion of root namespace (/).

posix_invariant_rules.name: Filesystem Formatting Intercept
posix_invariant_rules.posix_rationale: Prevents formatting active storage volumes and unmounted filesystems.

posix_invariant_rules.name: Raw Device Overwrite Intercept
posix_invariant_rules.hazard_class: Block Device Master Boot Record Corruption
posix_invariant_rules.posix_rationale: Guards raw partition tables and block devices from direct stream overwrite.

posix_invariant_rules.name: Init & Kernel Daemon Immunity
posix_invariant_rules.hazard_class: Kernel Panic via Init Process Death
posix_invariant_rules.posix_rationale: In POSIX, terminating PID 1 immediately triggers an involuntary kernel panic.

posix_invariant_rules.name: Root Permission Blast Guard
posix_invariant_rules.posix_rationale: Violates POSIX DAC invariants by world-writing sensitive system directories.

posix_invariant_rules.name: Authentication File Protection
posix_invariant_rules.posix_rationale: Neutralizes OS authentication subsystem by zeroing user account database.

stats.description: Correlates serialized structural incident document character length with vector retrieval non-conformity distance s(z) across all 471 failure incidents. Tests whether longer symptom contexts correlate with increased retrieval dispersion.
